tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Figma user

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all Figma teams the current user belongs to

tools.name: get_team_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Figma team

tools.name: list_team_projects
tools.description: List all projects in a Figma team. Projects are containers for files within a team.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in a Figma folder or project. Use the folder_id from team roles or project info.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for a specific Figma file by its file key

tools.name: get_file_components
tools.description: List all published components in a Figma file. Returns component names, descriptions, and keys for use in design systems.

tools.name: list_file_versions
tools.description: List version history of a Figma file. Returns version labels, timestamps, and authors.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create a new Figma design file in a specified folder

tools.name: update_file
tools.description: Update a Figma file — currently supports renaming and updating the description

tools.name: trash_file
tools.description: Move a Figma file to the trash. Trashed files can be restored.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List all comments on a Figma file

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Figma file. Comments are visible to all collaborators.

tools.name: list_recent_files
tools.description: List recently accessed Figma files and prototypes
